name: com.hawkes.playtest
description: The Hawkes playtest contract (v2) for Unity games: register scenarios and a bot coroutine, and a Hawkes runner can start, watch and report a playtest. WebGL: from the browser (window.hawkesPlaytest). Windows, Linux and macOS (Mono or IL2CPP): over a local WebSocket when the runner launches the game with HAWKES_PLAYTEST. Costs nothing until a playtest starts. Spec: hawkesstudio/docs/playtest.md.
